These obstacles can stifle creativity and limit revenue. With COREMERCH, you can bypass these restrictions and implement a robust, sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products directly to your audience using cryptocurrency. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad charge exorbitant fees that can cut deeply into your profits. For instance, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, while COREMERCH’s NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. By deploying your own stack, you gain true ownership of your revenue streams, allowing you to maximize your income potential. With this infrastructure, you also avoid the pitfalls of reliance on third-party platforms that can restrict access or impose sudden changes. You become the architect of your commerce, maintaining full sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you will need a few essential tools. First, create a GitHub account for hosting your store. Next, set up a NOWPayments account to facilitate your cryptocurrency transactions. Ensure you have at least three digital products ready for sale, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Familiarize yourself with the deployment process of your chosen stack, whether it’s the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Gathering these resources beforehand will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen stack, following the guidelines from the Sovereign Blueprint. This will involve configuring GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store's front end, and integrating NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery once payments are confirmed. Test the entire flow to ensure customers receive their products instantly upon payment. This step is crucial for maintaining customer trust and satisfaction.
Gain full ownership of your digital commerce without platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Promote your digital products through social media or your existing audience channels. Direct them to your newly established store link. When a customer makes a purchase, monitor the transaction through NOWPayments to verify payment confirmations. Aim for a smooth transaction experience, ensuring that customers receive their digital products promptly. This will establish credibility and encourage repeat business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial setup is successful, look into scaling your offerings. Introduce additional products to your store, utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for more resources and templates. Monitor sales trends to identify which products resonate most with your audience. Regularly update your marketing strategies to attract more customers. Ensure your infrastructure is capable of handling increased traffic and transactions to maintain a seamless experience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack built with COREMERCH. This stack enables you to host your store, process cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments, and automate product delivery without relying on traditional platforms. This method allows for greater profit retention and full ownership of your sales.
Automate delivery and payment processing with cutting-edge infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

You can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own sovereign digital commerce stack using COREMERCH. Utilize NOWPayments for crypto transactions, allowing you to keep more profits while automating delivery.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments over traditional platforms?

NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on transactions, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This means more profit retention for you. Additionally, there are no KYC requirements, making it easier for your customers.
Is technical knowledge required to set up my store?

While some basic tech skills can be helpful, our Sovereign Blueprints provide comprehensive documentation to guide you through the setup process. You can deploy your stack even with minimal technical knowledge.
Can I integrate multiple cryptocurrencies for payments?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you the flexibility to cater to a wider audience. Customers can pay in the currency they prefer, enhancing their purchasing experience.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered immediately after purchase?

By utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery processes, you ensure that products are sent to customers immediately upon payment confirmation, enhancing customer satisfaction.
Retain more profits compared to traditional platforms like Gumroad.
